payload.name: Dasha.fm
payload.summaryOriginal: Your Vedic chart in your AI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Connect Dasha.fm with OAuth to calculate and retrieve Vedic chart data for your AI assistant. Read your saved natal chart, Vimshottari dasha timeline and planetary transits without repeating your birth details. Save or replace your birth profile only after confirming the details. You can also calculate charts for supplied birth details, clarify an ambiguous birthplace, and view sky-only transits. Calculations use the Swiss Ephemeris, sidereal Lahiri zodiac, whole-sign houses and mean lunar nodes. Results include calculation conventions and warnings for approximate birth times. Dasha.fm supplies chart data; your AI assistant provides interpretations. Tropical/Placidus charts, tarot, bookings and payments are unsupported. Intended for adults using astrology for reflection, rather than medical, financial or legal decisions.

payload.description: 将任何想法转化为一首歌曲

payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Whim turns an idea, a story or lyrics into a real sung song, with music and its own cover art.

Tell ChatGPT what the song is about, or ask it to write the lyrics, and say "make it a real song". Add a sound if you have one in mind, like dreamy 80s synth-pop, late-night jazz or a big pop chorus. The song plays right in the chat.

Want to send it? Tap "Get a link to share" and your song gets its own page on onwhim.app.

Try a birthday song for a friend, a diss track for the dry texter, or what happened in your group chat last night.

Each person can make one song here. Full songs and more are coming in the Whim iPhone app, and you can join early access from the player.

payload.name: Cupid
payload.description: 在浪漫喜剧中扮演红娘
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Cupid is an interactive rom-com you play in ChatGPT.

Set in the five beautiful boroughs of New York City, you take on the role of Cupid, the divine matchmaker, guiding a Mortal you choose through a first date with a Match you pick. Every character runs on astrology as its emotional framework: they have different professions, obsessions, hang-ups and astral influences that shape how they flirt, fight and fall in love. An AI narrator, a celestial voice you suspect has spent the last millennium on the Upper West Side, guides you through the critical moments.

Your job is the first date: four short scenes, each ending in a choice for you to make. Every choice moves the story and the score. You can continue if you'd like, and when you've had enough, the Fates decide how it ends.

Season One: thirty-six New Yorkers, three matches each, and you on the arrow. The characters and their stories are fiction. The romance stays PG-13. Astrology is part of the fun, not a forecast.

Cupid needs no account and keeps no story: every game starts fresh. It keeps pseudonymous play records for analytics, as described in our privacy policy.

每个角色都以占星术作为情感框架：他们拥有不同的职业、痴迷点、心理阴影和星象影响，这些因素共同塑造了他们的调情方式、争吵模式和恋爱轨迹。

你的任务是完成第一次约会：四个短场景，每个场景以一个选择结束。
每个选择都会推动剧情发展和分数变化。
如果你想继续游玩，可以随时继续，当你觉得足够时，命运将决定结局。

第一季：36位纽约人，每位包含3个约会对象，而你就是掌控方向的箭头。
角色和故事均为虚构。
浪漫内容保持PG-13级别。
占星术是游戏元素之一，而非真实预测。

Cupid无需账号即可游玩，且不保存任何游戏记录：每次游戏都从头开始。
根据隐私政策，我们会对游玩记录进行匿名化处理以用于数据分析。

payload.name: Halloween Events Near Me
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Halloween Events Near Me helps you find real Halloween and fall events in a city or town in the US, Canada, the UK and Ireland, from the listings on halloween-events-near-me.com.

Ask for things like haunted houses this weekend, pumpkin patches and corn mazes, trick-or-treat and other kid-friendly events, free events, Halloween parties, or what's on near an event you already found. Results show as cards with the event's dates, town, distance, price and a scare rating for haunted attractions. Each card links to the full listing with a map, the organizer's website and more events nearby. You can also ask for the full details of one event: address, schedule, ages, parking, food and tips.

Who it's for: anyone planning Halloween outings, from families looking for trick-or-treat events to people looking for the scariest haunt in town.

Limitations: dates are checked against each event's own website, but organizers can change them, so check with the organizer before you go. Events whose dates for this season aren't confirmed yet are labeled. The app lists events; it doesn't sell tickets or take bookings, and it only covers the US, Canada, the UK and Ireland.

payload.name: Should I Fish?
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Should I Fish answers one question: should you fish a spot today or tomorrow? Ask about a town on the Virginia-to-Florida coast and it returns a Go, Maybe, or Skip verdict with its score, the best bite window for the day and why, high and low tide times from the nearest NOAA tide station, wind, moon phase, sunrise, and any active National Weather Service marine alert, called out first when one is in effect. It's built for recreational inshore and surf anglers, and for anyone at a coastal town wondering whether the morning is worth getting up for, across 136 towns on the Atlantic and Gulf coasts from Virginia through Florida. The plugin answers for today and tomorrow only. It does not forecast further ahead, identify species, say what's biting, or cover water outside Virginia-to-Florida. Tide predictions come from NOAA tide stations and marine alerts from the National Weather Service. The verdict is a model built from tide movement, solunar timing, barometric pressure trend, light, and wind: a guide for planning, not a guarantee of a catch, and not for navigation.
payload.longDescription:
Should I Fish？解答一个疑问：今天或明天是否应该在某个地点钓鱼？
查询弗吉尼亚州至佛罗里达州海岸线上的城镇，会返回Go（适合）、Maybe（可考虑）或Skip（不建议）的判断结果，包含当日最佳钓鱼时段及原因、最近NOAA潮汐站的高低潮时间、风速、月相、日出时间，以及任何生效中的国家气象局海洋警报（若有则优先显示）。
该插件专为休闲近海及冲浪垂钓者设计，也适合所有位于大西洋和墨西哥湾沿岸136个城镇的居民，判断清晨是否值得起床钓鱼。
插件仅提供今天和明天的信息。
它不进行更远期的预测，不识别鱼种、不说明哪种鱼正咬钩，也不覆盖弗吉尼亚州至佛罗里达州以外的水域。
潮汐预测数据来自NOAA潮汐站，海洋警报信息来自国家气象局。
判断结果基于潮汐运动、潮汐时间、气压趋势、光照和风速构建的模型，仅为规划参考，不保证一定有鱼获，也不用于航行导航。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Fishing verdict (Go / Maybe / Skip), Best bite window, Tide times

payload.name: Hunch Tarot
payload.description: 自拍塔罗，爱情与是/否解读
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
A personal tarot reading in ChatGPT, with you in the picture. Hunch turns your selfie into tarot art and creates a one-card reading around your question, your relationships or your next chapter.

Your face. Your question. A new way to see yourself.

Meet yourself in the cards
Your selfie becomes part of the artwork. See yourself through tarot symbolism, then explore what your card could mean for the moment you are in.

Find a question worth asking
• Card of the day — what deserves your attention today?
• Love tarot — what do you need to understand about this connection?
• Career tarot — what could help you take your next step?
• Personal growth — what are you ready to leave behind or begin?

Each experience includes
• Personalised AI tarot art created from your selfie
• A one-card tarot reading shaped by your question or theme
• Your card’s name, meaning and interpretation in the chat
• An optional handoff to the Hunch chat in WhatsApp, Telegram or iMessage, with a code for the same card

Make it personal
Upload a selfie and share what is on your mind. Hunch asks you to confirm your name, date of birth and artwork preference, using details already available in the conversation when possible. Once your card is ready, the artwork and full reading arrive together in ChatGPT.

Come back with a new question, a new perspective or simply a little curiosity. Ask for your daily tarot card whenever you want a moment to check in with yourself.

Try asking
“Turn my selfie into my tarot card of the day.”
“What should I do with the person I can’t stop thinking about?”
“Should I take the new job offer?”

No Hunch account is needed. Your confirmed details and selfie are sent to Hunch to create your card. Cards are created on request. Daily Tarot can help set up a daily card task when your ChatGPT chat supports scheduled tasks, Hunch tools and access to your approved selfie. Choose a time and time zone; generation remains subject to availability and usage limits. Multi-card spreads are not included. To receive your card in a messenger, open its button and send the prefilled message, or press Start in Telegram.

For entertainment and self-reflection, not guaranteed predictions or medical, legal or financial advice.
payload.longDescription:
在ChatGPT中的个人塔罗解读，让你出现在画面中。Hunch将你的自拍转化为塔罗艺术，并围绕你的问题、人际关系或人生新篇章生成单张牌解读。

你的面容。你的问题。一种全新的自我认知方式。

在牌中遇见自己。你的自拍将成为艺术作品的一部分。通过塔罗符号看见自己，探索这张牌对你当前处境可能意味着什么。

发现值得探讨的问题• 今日牌——今天什么值得你关注？• 爱情塔罗——你需要理解这段关系的什么？• 职业塔罗——什么能帮助你迈出下一步？• 个人成长——你准备好放下或开启什么？

每次体验包含• 由你的自拍生成的个性化AI塔罗艺术• 根据你的问题或主题定制的单张牌塔罗解读• 在聊天中显示牌名、含义及解读• 可选将解读转至WhatsApp、Telegram或iMessage的Hunch聊天，附带同一张牌的代码

让解读更个性化。上传自拍并分享你的想法。Hunch会请求你确认姓名、出生日期和艺术风格偏好，尽可能使用对话中已有的信息。当卡片准备就绪，艺术作品和完整解读会同时出现在ChatGPT中。

带着新问题、新视角或仅仅是些许好奇心再次回来。随时索取你的每日塔罗牌，给自己一个与内心对话的时刻。

尝试提问：「把我的自拍变成今天的塔罗牌？」「我该如何处理这个我无法停止思念的人？」「我应该接受这份新工作邀约吗？」

无需Hunch账户。您确认的详细信息和自拍将被发送至Hunch以生成卡片。卡片是按需生成的。当您的ChatGPT聊天支持定时任务、Hunch工具及已批准的自拍访问权限时，Daily Tarot可帮助设置每日卡片任务。选择时间与时区；生成仍需遵循可用性和使用限制。不包含多张牌阵。要通过聊天应用接收卡片，请打开其按钮并发送预填信息，或在Telegram中点击开始。

仅供娱乐和自我反思，不保证预测结果或提供医疗、法律、财务建议。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Create personalised tarot art from a selfie, Get a card of the day with a personal reading, Explore love and career questions with tarot, Reopen your existing card and reading, Continue with your card in WhatsApp, Telegram or iMessage, Arrange a daily card schedule where ChatGPT supports it

payload.name: Playlistable
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Playlistable is an AI playlist generator for Spotify and Apple Music. Describe a mood, a night, or a job to be done, and it builds a playlist in your own library — not a copy of a list you already have.

In ChatGPT you can:

- Generate a playlist from a mood.
- Search songs or artists on the connected catalog, then save a playlist from the tracks you picked.
- List, open, refine, edit, or delete playlists you already created.

Sign in with Spotify or Apple Music through Playlistable OAuth. Playlists land in Your Library on the connected service. The same product is on the web at https://app.playlistable.io and at https://playlistable.io.

We do not sell a music catalog. We write playlists into the account you connect.
payload.longDescription:
Playlistable是Spotify和Apple Music的AI播放列表生成器。描述一种情绪、一个夜晚或一项任务，它会根据你的个人音乐库创建播放列表——而不是复制你已有的列表。

在ChatGPT中你可以：

· 根据情绪生成播放列表
· 在连接的音乐目录中搜索歌曲或艺术家，然后保存你挑选的曲目播放列表
· 列出、打开、优化、编辑或删除你已创建的播放列表

通过Playlistable OAuth使用Spotify或Apple Music登录。播放列表会保存到连接服务的「我的图书馆」中。同一产品可在网页端https://app.playlistable.io和https://playlistable.io访问。

我们不销售音乐目录。我们把生成的播放列表写入你连接的账户中。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Generate a playlist from a mood for Spotify or Apple Music, Save a playlist from songs you already picked, Search songs and artists on the connected catalog, Refine a playlist with a short instruction, Add or remove specific tracks, List and open playlists in the connected music service

payload.name: GoTickets
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: GoTickets helps users discover live events, compare ticket listings by all-in price, seat quality, section, accessibility, and delivery attributes, read published policies, and continue to checkout through a direct GoTickets URL.
payload.longDescription: GoTickets帮助用户发现现场活动，通过全价、座位质量、区域、无障碍设施和配送属性等维度对比票务列表，查看已发布政策，并通过直接的GoTickets网址继续结账。

payload.name: CCUCheck
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Live player counts and trends for Roblox games, right in ChatGPT. Ask how many people are playing any Roblox game and see its player chart for the last 7 days. Find the most played Roblox games right now, or the top games in a genre like simulator, obby, tycoon or roleplay. Spot established games that are growing fastest this week, and compare up to six games on one chart over 7 to 90 days. Made for Roblox developers researching genres and competitors, and for players curious about what is popular. Every game links to its page on CCUCheck and on Roblox. CCUCheck is independent and not affiliated with Roblox Corporation.
payload.longDescription: 在ChatGPT中实时查看Roblox游戏的玩家数量与趋势。询问任何Roblox游戏的当前玩家数量，并查看其过去7天的玩家数量图表。实时获取当前最热门的Roblox游戏，或查看模拟类、障碍赛、经营类、角色扮演等分类中的热门游戏。发现本周增长最快的传统热门游戏，并可在7至90天周期内将最多六款游戏绘制在同一张趋势图中。本工具专为研究游戏类型与竞品的Roblox开发者，以及想了解热门游戏的玩家设计。每款游戏均链接至CCUCheck平台及Roblox官方页面。CCUCheck为独立平台，与Roblox公司无任何关联。

payload.name: TodoWeekend
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
TodoWeekend is an independent guide to things to do on the weekend in Madrid, Barcelona, Lisboa, Paris, Berlin, London, Miami, Santiago de Chile and Tokyo. Ask what is on this weekend, today or tomorrow, or for concerts, exhibitions, theatre, family plans or free events. You get up to 12 curated listings as cards, with the date, venue, price when known, and a link to the TodoWeekend page. Ask for details on any listing to see the full description, address, map point and the seller's own ticket link.

Limits: TodoWeekend covers only the nine cities above. Listings are suitable for ages 13 and up, and nightlife and alcohol-led events are left out. Every answer shows the date the city's data was last updated, and a notice appears when it is more than seven days old, so check the event page before you go. TodoWeekend does not sell tickets and does not need an account. The plugin only reads public listings.
payload.longDescription:
TodoWeekend是马德里、巴塞罗那、里斯本、巴黎、柏林、伦敦、迈阿密、圣地亚哥和东京的周末活动独立指南。询问本周、今天或明天的活动安排，或了解音乐会、展览、戏剧、家庭活动及免费活动信息。您将获得最多12条精选列表卡片，显示日期、场所、已知价格及跳转至TodoWeekend页面的链接。可查看任意列表的详细信息，包含完整描述、地址、地图标记及卖家提供的票务链接。

限制条件：TodoWeekend仅覆盖上述九个城市。所有活动适合13岁及以上人群，不包含夜生活及以酒精为主的活动。每次回答会显示城市数据最后更新日期，若超过七天未更新会特别提示，请出行前查看活动页面。TodoWeekend不销售门票，无需账户即可使用。插件仅读取公开列表。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: List covered cities, Find weekend events, Get event details
